codesAdminOnly: Only an admin can download, import or remove diagnosis codes.
codesBusy: This code set is already being downloaded or imported. Wait a moment and try again.
codesDownloadFailed: The download did not work ({error}). Check the internet connection, or download the file on another computer and import it.
codesWrongRelease: The downloaded file is not the expected release. Update OpenVision or import the file yourself.
codesImportWrongRelease: This file is not the expected release ({release}). Use the official file from {url}, unchanged.
codesBadZip: The zip file could not be read: {error}
codesTooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB, so it is not a code-set file.
codesBodyLimit: This file is larger than the server accepts. Ask your administrator to start the server with BODY_SIZE_LIMIT=20M, or import the zip file instead of the text file.
codesRemoveCurrent: The practice codes with this set. Choose another code set in Settings › Practice before removing it.
mustChangePassword: Change your temporary password first, in My settings.
